title: TestBuildWithoutARevisionPacksNothing fails wherever CS_SANDBOX_IMAGE is set, as make test-integration sets it
foundBy: session agent, running make test-integration while verifying SBX-091

evidence.verified: `go test -tags integration ./internal/cli/ -run '^TestBuildWithoutARevisionPacksNothing$'` passes on cf550a1, with CS_SANDBOX_IMAGE unset and with it set to an image. Before cf550a1 the same test failed with it set. `make ci` on cf550a1 passed.

resolution: The test clears CS_SANDBOX_IMAGE, so the build it runs has to name its image from its version, and it meets the refusal under test.
details: The test builds with no version and expects the refusal of a build that cannot name its image. `make test-integration` sets CS_SANDBOX_IMAGE, and a build takes its image name from there. So it passes that refusal and meets a later one about the module version, and the test fails although the build is still refused. It fails only in that target, which no gate runs, so nobody saw it.
